context.author: Codex /root/english_evaluation, independent source-reading evaluator
context.selection: Owner explicitly selected English and the existing Raveldex documentation.
context.need: Existing 34-section English technical documentation corpus uses singular/plural, participle and nominal headings; strict basic-v1 treats these word forms separately. Existing natural-question gaps also show why morphology must not be called semantic answering.
context.labelMethod: Read actual frozen source headings and assign navigation-relevant sources before executing the English production analyzer. Preserve source bytes, labels and hash after freeze.
context.limitations: One English-reading AI evaluator; 34 English technical self-documentation sections; title-only word-form navigation deliberately bounded for complete labels. Not native-human review, representative user study or general English relevance guarantee.
